title: cdk-construct-kinesis-stream examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-kinesis-stream/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — defaults
- provisioned/ — streamMode PROVISIONED with explicit shardCount (divergent: different capacity model)
- on-demand/ — streamMode ON_DEMAND (divergent: serverless capacity)
- with-consumers/ — consumerCount > 0 (divergent: adds Enhanced Fan-Out consumers)

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/kinesis-stream-examples.test.ts.

comments.author: lead-engineer
